verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies an official client-side SDK: it describes integrating Identity Verification through Plaid Link and using Link's client-side callbacks (onEvent, onSuccess). Alongside that, it documents API endpoints such as /identity_verification/retry, but none of the cited items explicitly names official SDKs or client libraries. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official server-side SDKs or client libraries and the languages they cover, any SDK reference docs or install instructions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
